Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) to identify the CSDE1 interactome. While the study focuses heavily on phosphorylation (using 2D-gels and phosphatase treatment to prove the effect of phosphorylation on binding), the PRIDE metadata for the MS dataset specifically notes 'No PTMs are included in the dataset', suggesting the MS was used for protein identification/quantification of the interactors rather than site-specific phosphoproteomics. However, the biological goal is PTM-driven, so phosphorylation is listed as a search hint.

scope: We used immunoprecipitation (IP) of CSDE1 followed by identification of associated proteins using mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS)
CSDE1 IPs were performed using 700 μg of SK-Mel-147 and Mel-ST extracts, or 2000 μg of adult melanocyte extracts, with 10 μg antibody and 50 μL Dynabeads.
Following IP, half of the beads were incubated with RNase I (Ambion AM2294) in IPP150 buffer at 25°C for 15 min.
